description: Step 1. No map yet: just a scatter plot. Longitude on x, latitude on y, exactly like any x/y chart. 'zero: false' stops the axes starting at 0. Notice the shape is squashed: at UK latitudes, one degree of longitude is only about 69 km, but one degree of latitude is about 111 km.

title.text: Step 1: UK airports as a scatter plot
title.subtitle: x = longitude, y = latitude (in degrees)
